turns.doctor_question: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. Thank you for coming in today. What brings you to see me?
turns.patient_response:
Hello, Doctor. Thank you for fitting me in, I really appreciate it. 

Um, well, I guess I'm here because... I've been having some trouble at work, and my wife thought it would be a good idea to talk to someone. I hope it's okay that I'm starting with that. 

I do mathematical modeling, mostly for environmental contracts. And, well, I don't want to sound unprofessional or anything—I'm usually very easy to work with, I promise—but lately... I'm pretty sure the people on this one specific contract have been tracking my revisions. 

It's just that these errors keep showing up in the datasets, and... well, I think they're planting them there to make it look like I'm incompetent. Like I can't lead the work anymore. My wife and the junior analysts at the office, they're very supportive, and they keep telling me it's just normal version-control mistakes. Just standard computer glitches, you know? 

And I really don't want to be a difficult person or make a fuss if it's nothing, but... it really feels like someone is doing it on purpose. Am I explaining that clearly enough? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
